package.description: An innovative, convenient and secure cross-platform crypto app.

en-US.description: An innovative, convenient and secure cross-platform crypto app.
en-US.longDescription: Crypter is a cross-platform crypto app that makes encryption and decryption convenient while still upholding strong security. It tackles one of the weakest links in most security systems today - weak passwords. It simplifies secure password generation and management and requires you to only remember one bit - your MasterPass.
en-US.name: Crypter
